name: Rambox
description: Rambox uses electron-updater with a GitHub feed and an IPC-triggered quit-and-install path. SHA512 and platform code-signature enforcement are delegated to electron-updater/package tooling and remain unresolved in this application-source review.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; historical release behavior is not reverified.
The cited app source delegates digest and platform-signature enforcement to electron-updater and its packaging/runtime dependencies.
